configurePresets.name: conan-windows-x86-release
configurePresets.description: 32-bit (Win32) Release build. Binary dir and Conan toolchain both live in the game's single build tree: kishin_hisho/build/helper. Ninja takes its target architecture from the compiler environment, not from CMake, so the 32-bit target comes from the x86 Conan profile's conanvcvars.bat -- which is why there is no 'architecture' field here.
